eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED WEEKLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Anoka, MN; at 5:42 AM on JUL 27, 2026 Effective until 5:57 AM. Message from MN HSEM.
extra_text: This is a coordinated weekly test of the broadcast stations in your area. If this had been an actual emergency, official messages would have followed the alert tone. This concludes a test of the Emergency Alert System. This is only a test.
